patches.reason: Check Win32 commit/protection failures, ignore zero-size pre-commit protection, flush instruction cache on RX; protection failure terminates with diagnostic and 0xAEE00001 instead of returning through potentially non-executable dispatcher memory.

Per-instance noexcept observers for actual block lookup and compilation evidence. Also implements original live-SP alignment IR and terminal fault prefix-cycle accounting for the Windows x64/A64 profile (ADR0343).

Invoke block observers on real cache hit/miss and after Emit seals generated code RX; measure compilation with steady_clock. Reject non-canonical raw program counters before descriptor masking can alias a valid cached code address. ADR0395: preserve queued cache invalidation across CPU Reset using the existing request mutex and authoritative pending state.

Initialize Windows exception metadata before PreludeComplete makes its code allocation RX. Also implements original live-SP alignment IR and terminal fault prefix-cycle accounting for the Windows x64/A64 profile (ADR0343). ADR0346 adds a post-cache-callback MemoryAbort guard preserving fault PC and prefix charging before subsequent IR; successful cache behavior unchanged.
Use Windows atomic intrinsics for host spinlock operations; eliminate global Xbyak RWX allocation before main. Retain inline JIT spinlock emitters and non-Windows original path.
